# Carcavelos Daily Brief – 10 November 2026

**Solid 4m+ swell all day with manageable winds—classic autumn conditions.**

**MORNING (05:22–11:00)**
Get up early. 4.3m average with the best shape between 05:00–07:00 when winds are lightest (17–20km/h) and swell sits fat at 4+ metres. After 08:00, wind picks up to 22–25km/h, adding texture but keeping it fun. Window closes around 11:00 as southerly flow kicks in harder.

**AFTERNOON (12:00–16:00)**
Swell drops to 3m but doesn't fall apart. Wind climbs to 27km/h by midday before easing slightly. Waves stay surfable but messier. The swell period stretches (9.2s→10.2s), which helps with shape on the inside.

**Key tips:**
- Bring a mid-length; punchy 4m walls need something responsive
- Hit it dawn patrol or wait until 14:00+ when wind drops
- Carcavelos gets crowded by 08:00—come early or late
